title: Complete Nonderogatory to Cyclic Vector: The General Case (All Fields)

problemStatement.formal: theorem nonderogatory_has_cyclic_vector_any_field {K : Type*} [Field K] {n : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K) (h : IsNonderogatory M) : ∃ v, IsCyclicVector M v
problemStatement.plain: If M ∈ Mₙ(K) is nonderogatory (minpoly = charpoly) over ANY field K (including finite fields with |K| ≤ n), then M has a cyclic vector v such that {v, Mv, …, Mⁿ⁻¹v} is a basis. This is the field-independent version completing the Cayley-Hamilton minpoly research cluster.
whyMatters: Removes the [Infinite K] hypothesis from OQ-05-OQ-01 — the theorem holds universally
Resolves the last sorry in CayleyHamiltonMinpolyOQ05OQ01OQ04.lean
Completes the nonderogatory/cyclic-vector thread in the Cayley-Hamilton gallery cluster
Requires a proof route that avoids the full PID structure theorem (not in Mathlib)
Forces exploration of companion matrix similarity or direct span arguments in Lean 4

proven: aeval_conj: conjugation by invertible P commutes with polynomial evaluation aeval M
cyclic_vector_of_similar: if M ~ M' and v is cyclic for M', then there is a cyclic vector for M
annihilator_dvd_minpoly: if p(M)v = 0 then minpoly K M ∣ p
cyclic_iff_ann_eq_minpoly: v cyclic ↔ ann_K[X](v) = (minpoly K M)
F2_union_covers: F₂² is covered by 3 proper subspaces (union avoidance fails over F₂)

knowledge.progressSummary: NEW: Selected by Seeker. Prior work (oq-05-oq-01 through incomplete-01) has proved all auxiliary lemmas; only the main sorry remains. The direct PID route is blocked; alternative routes (companion matrix, span argument) need Mathlib survey.
insights: The blocking step is the PID structure theorem: K^n ≅ K[X]/(d1) ⊕ … ⊕ K[X]/(dr) as K[X]-modules
nonderogatory forces r=1 in the cyclic decomposition, giving K^n ≅ K[X]/(minpoly)
cyclic_iff_ann_eq_minpoly (already proven) reduces the problem to: ∃ v, ann(v) = (minpoly)
companion matrix approach: if M ~ companion(charpoly), then e1 is a cyclic vector for companion, and cyclic_vector_of_similar transfers it to M
Whether rational canonical form / companion similarity exists in Mathlib is the key unknown

Matrix.rationaCanonicalForm or Matrix.isConj_companion for nonderogatory matrices
